messages.subject: Re: `strapply` unexpected results
messages.body_plain: tcl uses [[:<:]] and [[:>:]] for beginning and end word boundaries (rather than \b) so use pattern <- "(.*?):]]" See this page for tcl 8.5 regular expressions https://www.tcl.tk/man/tcl8.5/TclCmd/re_syntax.htm On Saturday, March 1, 2014 9:48:28 PM UTC-5, Brodie Gaslam wrote: > Apologies, new to google groups and can't figure out how to do code formatting. Consider: > > pattern <- "(.*?) txt <- 'FiOS Internet and TV1-888-881-8161' > > > strapply(txt, pattern, simplify=rbind) > NULL > > strapply(txt, pattern, simplify=rbind, engine="R") > [,1] > [1,] "FiOS Internet and TV" > > vs. expected: > > [,1] [,2] > [1,] "FiOS Internet and TV" "1-888-881-8161" > > Am I doing something wrong here? >
messages.body_snippet: tcl uses [[:<:]] and [[:>:]] for beginning and end word boundaries (rather than \b) so use pattern <- "(.*?):]]" S
